feeds.title: You Need a Budget
feeds.description: You Need a Budget combines easy software with Four Simple Rules to help you quickly gain control of your money, get out of debt, and save more money faster! We teach you how to gain control of your money so you can stop living paycheck to paycheck, get out of debt, and save more money faster.

feeds.title: Budgets Are Sexy
feeds.description: J. Money is the rockstar of budget blogs! This guy gives an in-depth look at his personal finances, as well as lifetime goals. He has a fresh and different approach to money, and life, where a good budget=confidence=sexy! He has some interesting money challenges, side hustles, and early retirement plans for you to implement and learn from.

feeds.title: The Budget Mom Blog
feeds.description: The ultimate resource for simple, easy-to-follow solutions to help you budget your money, pay off debt, save more, and crush your financial goals.

feeds.title: The Budget Babe
feeds.description: Featuring the latest cheap-chic fashion news, designer and celebrity looks-for-less, and honest reports on the places you all love to shop. The Budget Babe is a affordable fashion blog for style-conscious women everywhere who are looking to stretch their wardrobe dollars.

feeds.title: Family Budgeting Blog
feeds.description: Covers all aspects of frugal family life, full of ideas for living creatively as a family on a budget. Top UK parenting blog written by Becky Goddard Hill, an award winning thrifty blogger.

feeds.title: Goodbudget Blog
feeds.description: Keep track of money to spend, save, and give toward what's important in life. Goodbudget is personal budget software based on the envelope budgeting method. It's available on the Web, Android, and iPhone.

feeds.title: Budget Fashionista
feeds.description: Since 2003, Budget Fashionista has been a beacon for fashion-conscious women, offering empowering insights on looking fabulous without breaking the bank. The Budget Fashionista community invites women of all ages to discover the art of styling, smart shopping, staying on-trend, and achieving a stunning look without a hefty price tag. Join this vibrant community to unlock the secrets of affordable fashion and embrace a stylish life on a budget.

feeds.title: Sustainable Cooks
feeds.description: Sharing delicious and healthy recipes, budgeting ideas, gardening tips, DIY, and crafting with humor and humanity. Frugal by Choice, Cheap by Necessity is about living a champagne life on a sparkling cider budget! Sustainable Cooks is your guide to real food for really busy people.

feeds.title: Australian Family and Fertility Law
feeds.description: Join Award-Winning Family & Surrogacy Lawyers, Bruce Provan and Stephen Page who interviews lawyers, doctors, counsellors, parents, surrogates, scientists, donors and others who are the moving parts bringing together the ability to form families through surrogacy, and when families fall apart. Interviewees talk about their personal journeys through life, leading to their passion in their respective fields.

feeds.title: The Budget Decorator
feeds.description: The Budget Decorator, Decorating Your Small Space and The Garden Glove. Our aim is to make sure through our sites that you always have a budget DIY home and garden project, idea or inspiration ready for you, 365 days out of the year!

feeds.title: Penny Pinchin Mom Blog
feeds.description: Hii! I'm Tracie! I am a mom of 3 amazing kids! I share tips to help people get out of debt, save money, budget, make amazing recipes, parenting tips, and more!

feeds.title: Simply Frugal Blog
feeds.description: My name is Taya and I'm a mom to two beautiful little girls born in 2012 and 2016 and wife to an amazingly supportive husband as well as the founder of Simply Frugal. I began Simply Frugal in February 2009 after I saw a need for a more personable and approachable Money-saving site for Canadians.

feeds.title: Canadian Budget Binder
feeds.description: Canadian Budget Binder By Mr.CBB is about Family, Finance, Frugal Living, Relationships, Recipes + Keto. You will learn how to take back control over your money by using our free budget and more.

feeds.title: Believe in a Budget Blog
feeds.description: Believe In A Budget is designed to help build a better bludget, blog and business.

feeds.title: Frugal Frolicker
feeds.description: Featuring travel adventures around the world, travel photography, budget travel tips, and travel guides. Frugal Frolicker is a travel blog by Lindsay Buckley.

feeds.title: Mom Managing Chaos » Budgeting
feeds.description: My name is Kristen and I am obsessed with helping you simplify and organize your life and finances to get you on track to a life you love and love to live! I am constantly learning, studying, and course-correcting my crazy life! I want to show you that budgeting isn't scary, share tips on how to save you money every month, and how to tame the chaos in your life.

feeds.title: Budget Traveller
feeds.description: Travel can be had even if you're on a small budget and this blog is here to show you how. Start saving up and give this site a few visits for tips on how to plan a trip that you can afford. Whether it's discovering luxury hostels or the best cheap eats or budget places to stay in Paris or London, BudgetTraveller has it all covered.

feeds.title: Living Richly on a Budget
feeds.description: Blog by Fanny Seto help busy people simplify their finances so they can be more in control of their money and future, through my book, Budgeting Made Easy.

feeds.title: BeCentsational
feeds.description: Living a champagne lifestyle on a lemonade Budget. Resources on living a healthy, wealthy and happy life.

feeds.title: Jessi Fearon
feeds.description: I love sharing my real life on budget through my blog, Jessi Fearon in hopes of inspiring others who are walking down the road to financial freedom. My goal is to use the natural gifts that God has given me to coach others to do the same. This is where I share our family's real life on a budget so we can encourage you to realize your dreams and experience financial freedom.

feeds.title: Family Travels on a Budget
feeds.description: Family Travels on a Budget: Learn about cool places to visit in the US, theme park family deals, cruise ships for kids, and the best cruise lines for teens at this travel with kids blog. Couples and girlfriend getaways are also covered because we all need a break sometimes.

feeds.title: Lifestyle On A Budget
feeds.description: Welcome to Lifestyle on a Budget (formerly THE TEEN RUNWAY). Get more insights on how to live the lifestyle you crave on a budget that won't break the bank.

feeds.title: Frugal Fanatic Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles to learn how to budget so that you can save money and make more money, how to set up a simple budget so you can get out of debt and start saving money. Frugal Fanatic was created to help you learn how to gain control of your finances.

feeds.title: Living Well Spending Less Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles on smart money tips, simple living, life skills and more. Living Well Spending Less shares practical Solutions for Everyday Overwhelm.

feeds.title: The Busy Budgeter
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Rosemarie. I'm the creator of Busy Budgeter. I will help you get your budgeting and money-saving goals under control. My blog will help you to manage your finances, create a successful budget, and find legitimate ways to make more money.

feeds.title: Snazzy Little Things Blog
feeds.description: Explore Snazzy Little Things Blog, a haven for budget-friendly DIY enthusiasts seeking easy, quick tutorials for home decoration and improvement. From decorating ideas to DIY projects, discover accessible techniques to enhance your home's beauty on any budget.

feeds.title: Budgeting Couple » Save Money
feeds.description: Welcome to Budgeting Couple, the key to financial success is steady improvement across all aspects of life. But initiating that first step forward is always the hardest part. That's why we aim to provide simple, actionable advice. Whether it be a habit, hack, or truth, we hope you find something to make your next step forward a little bit easier. We help you see that you have enough money. Learn simple money management techniques to eliminate your daily money stress

feeds.title: Inspired Budget Blog
feeds.description: Allison Baggerly is a budget expert who shares budget tips, debt-free stories, how to pay off debt, save money, frugal activities, frugal gift guides, and frugal cooking.

feeds.title: Budgeting In the Fun Stuff
feeds.description: Budgeting in the Fun Stuff is a personal finance blog that covers spending, savings, Budgeting, Financial Advice, and the fun stuff along the way.

feeds.title: Indian Budget Beauty
feeds.description: Hey everyone, This is Trishna, a 20 year old student who fancies all things related to makeup and beauty. I call myself a makeup enthusiast who wants to test and review all budget beauty products and become a helping hand to those who share the same passion with me.

feeds.title: CBGA India
feeds.description: Get insights in the budget management. Centre for Budget and Governance Accountability (CBGA) is a think-tank focusing on public policies and government finances in India. It promotes transparent and accountable governance.

feeds.title: Simple Living Mommy
feeds.description: Discover how to live simply, frugally, and more naturally in a fast-paced world. Join me as I figure out how to incorporate these goals in parenthood! Get Practical tips for living a full, happy life on a budget!

feeds.title: Life and a Budget
feeds.description: Blog by Latoya. I created this space to help you learn how to manage your finances better so you can live a carefree lifestyle, free of money worries!

feeds.title: Easy Budget
feeds.description: Hey, I'm Merilee. I help people pay off debt fast and gain total control of their finances and It all starts with a well-designed budget. My husband and I got serious about our family's finances in 2017. We paid off $71,000 of consumer and student loan debt and 6Xed our net worth in less than 4 years using the tools we now share.

feeds.title: Frugal Beautiful Blog
feeds.description: A blog for women that want to rock their budget and thus, their life. Learning to be blissful while broke is what it's all about! Frugality doesn't have to be ugly! FruBeau is dedicated to women who want the best in life but don't want to pay for it in monthly installments at a high interest rate!

feeds.title: Frugal Living NW
feeds.description: Sharing different ways to save money: grocery and drug store sales, online deals, homemaking tips and recipes, and frugal fun ideas. Frugal Living NW is a blog devoted to living well on a budget in the Pacific Northwest.

feeds.title: Broke and Beautiful » Budget
feeds.description: The original budget fashion & lifestyle blog about living the BrokeLife! Living the cheap life without breaking the bank. Budget shopping tips for affordable fashion & style, cheap home decor, budget friendly recipes, & free music downloads! We love eco fashion, sustainable design, and environmentally friendly products.

feeds.title: The Frugal Cottage » Budgeting
feeds.description: Features articles on budgeting, investing, and early retirement. The Frugal Cottage assists you with financial freedom and living the good life on a budget.

feeds.title: Debt Discipline » Pay Off Debt
feeds.description: How a family of 5 deals with Money, Budgets and most of all Debt. Mission is to teach people how to live debt free.

feeds.title: BudgetSimple.com Blog
feeds.description: Easy to use, free online budget. Get your household finances in order quickly with our budget planner, get out of debt, and build savings.

feeds.title: Our Freaking Budget
feeds.description: This is Joanna and Johnny's personal finance blog where they document their love/hate relationship with their freaking budget and all things money. they talk about money stuff for normal-ish people.

feeds.title: Looking Fly on a Dime
feeds.description: Affordable style expert helping women look their best, for less. Looking Fly on a Dime author. Thrift shopping pro. Glitter in my veins.

feeds.title: The Painted Hive
feeds.description: The Painted Hive blog is dedicated to budget-friendly DIY ideas for interior design and home decoration with a focus on real projects, fresh ideas, and evocative inspiration. Author Kristine writes crispy articles focusing on real projects, fresh ideas, and evocative inspiration. She loves the creative challenge and self-satisfaction which comes from decorating on a budget.

feeds.title: Cooking On A Budget
feeds.description: This site is dedicated to showing you that even with a limited grocery budget you can cook good meals for your family. There are lots of menu plans, helpful advice and tips and many tried and true recipes. Some of them from my family archives. I hope you enjoy your visit here at Cooking On A Budget.

feeds.title: Chic on the Cheap
feeds.description: Connecticut based personal style blog by Lydia Abate, based on a budget; because you should never sacrifice style for savings.

feeds.title: Debt Help Tools
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Lindsey and I really love helping people & businesses get their money organized & their systems optimized. (I'm a bit weird I know) I have an MBA in finance & have been a self-employed management consultant since 2013. I've been super privileged to work on a wide range of projects in that time & each one has been an amazing opportunity to learn something new. This site aims to create a bank for that knowledge so that you can shortcut your journey to success & hopefully skip all the mistakes that I made!

feeds.title: GrowingSlower Blog
feeds.description: GrowingSlower is the real mom's guide to simple living on a budget! Simple strategies for real moms for saving money, working at home, & simple living.

feeds.title: BudgetTracker
feeds.description: BudgetTracker.com was founded in 2003. We provide a way to track your budget easily from any internet connection or any cellular phone, so that you can enter in your transactions as they happen. Our first goal was to provide a complete, easy, and customizable budgeting solution.

feeds.title: Singapore's Budget Babe
feeds.description: Find articles from Singapore's leading financial lifestyle blogger. Budget Babe is an ordinary lady striving to achieve financial freedom in Singapore before the age of 45. She is always looking for cost-effective ways to live a fulfilling life amidst Singapore's rising costs and writes in order to empower fellow Singaporeans on taking charge of their own lives and finances.

feeds.title: City Girl Savings
feeds.description: City Girl Savings is an online community that offers budgeting and financial coaching services to help women achieve a financially successful lifestyle. We also offer ongoing coaching services and personalized budget plans for clients who need assistance reaching financial goals. Follow this site to get strategic budgeting services and money-saving methods to reach financial success!

feeds.title: Budget and the Beach
feeds.description: Follow the journey of a freelance video editor and blogger living in Los Angeles, as she navigates the rocky road of being a solopreneur, and continues to enjoy a healthy and fit lifestyle on a budget.

feeds.title: A Bee to Money saving one penny at a time
feeds.description: Hello and welcome! I'm a thirty-something millennial who has lived her entire life debt-free. No credit, college or mortgage debt! And now I'm looking for new ways to save. From coupons to cash-back credit cards to investing apps - it's all a small step towards big savings.

feeds.title: Care to Keep | How to Make Things Last
feeds.description: Care to Keep is a place to find out exactly how to take care of things so they last. Taking good care of things is a respectful, grateful way to live. And it can also help save money and lessen our negative impact on the environment by reducing waste and consumption.
